# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.3.0 - 2026-11-04

- First version in this marketplace: the Duende Skills skills and agents, copied from https://github.com/DuendeSoftware/duende-skills at commit `fb32edc`.
- Skill and agent files are unchanged from the vendor's.
- The vendor's plugin-level files (`.claude-plugin/`, `.codex-plugin/`, `.agents/`, `.github/`, `scripts/`, `tests/`, `assets/`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`) are not included. BoldCreate Connect delivers only skills, agents, rules and hooks.
